title: false-self-employment-check-hero
subject: A composed freelancer at a bright desk reviews a simple checklist card with five abstract check items beside a laptop, symbolising a structured self-check of employment status — one item subtly highlighted in amber, clarity instead of legal anxiety.
context: Beraterium blog hero for the article on false self-employment (Scheinselbststaendigkeit): how to recognise the criteria, the 83% rule of thumb and the official status determination procedure. Theme: checking your own status calmly and systematically. Warm, professional B2B editorial, reassuring, not stock photo, no courtroom or legal-drama clichés.

platform_website.optimized_variants: Build creates scheinselbststaendigkeit-pruefen-hero.webp plus -480w, -960w, -1440w responsive WebP from the PNG source
platform_website.best_practice_notes: Wide 16:9 hero; single freelancer plus one clear checklist card as focal points; generous negative space in upper third; readable at thumbnail and full width.
platform_website.safe_zone: Keep main subject in central 90% width; avoid critical detail in extreme left/right 5% and bottom 10%.

composition.depth: foreground one clean checklist card with five abstract tick rows on the desk, midground focused freelancer with laptop and coffee cup, soft background modern workspace with window light

lighting.style: soft warm natural window light with gentle falloff

style.mood: calm, methodical, self-assured — checking facts, not fearing an audit

ai_disclosure.placement: small legible label in the bottom-right corner of the image; never alt-text only
ai_disclosure.prompt_instruction: Small legible caption text 'KI-generiertes Bild' in the bottom-right corner: small clean sans-serif, white at ~70% opacity, unobtrusive but readable.

optional_text_overlay.typography: Prefer no text on image — article H1 renders above hero.
optional_text_overlay.prompt_instruction: No readable text on the checklist card; abstract tick rows and shapes only, one row highlighted in amber.

negative_prompt: no watermarks or text except the small AI-disclosure label bottom right
no readable text on card or screen (only exception: the small AI-disclosure label bottom right)
no courtroom, gavel or paragraph-symbol clichés
no anxious or distressed facial expression
no identifiable real persons or celebrities

seo.alt_text: Freelancerin prüft anhand einer Kriterienliste ihren Selbstständigkeits-Status am Schreibtisch
seo.caption: Scheinselbstständigkeit systematisch prüfen – fünf Kriterien und die 83-%-Faustregel.

generation_prompt_single_block_en: Landscape editorial photograph 1920x1080, 16:9. Bright modern workspace, navy charcoal tones (#1F2A44) with cyan (#00A3FF) and amber (#F2B134) accents. Midground: composed freelancer in smart casual at a tidy desk with laptop and coffee cup, calmly reviewing one clean checklist card. Foreground: the checklist card with five abstract tick rows (no readable text), one row subtly highlighted in amber. Soft warm window light from left, medium-low contrast, methodical self-assured mood — someone checking facts, not fearing an audit. Generous negative space upper third for blog header. Clean editorial realism, medium-high detail. In the bottom-right corner add a small legible caption text 'KI-generiertes Bild' in a small clean sans-serif, white at about 70% opacity — unobtrusive but readable at full width and thumbnail size. No other readable text, no watermarks, no third-party logos, no courtroom or paragraph-symbol clichés, no alarm symbols, no distorted hands. Safe zone: main subject central 90% width.
